import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
I,O=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
# centers of blocks (nonzero blocks): find blocks of value 2 (frame) and their center cell
import collections
# find all 3x3 blocks
R,C=len(I),len(I[0])
centers={}
for r in range(R-2):
    for c in range(C-2):
        if I[r][c]==2 and I[r][c+2]==2 and I[r+2][c]==2 and I[r+2][c+2]==2 and I[r+1][c]==2 and I[r][c+1]==2:
            centers[(r+1,c+1)]=I[r+1][c+1]
print(len(centers))
cnt=collections.Counter(centers.values())
print(cnt)
print({k:v for k,v in centers.items() if v in (1,3)})
# diff between I and O
diff=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
print(len(diff))
print(collections.Counter(d[3] for d in diff), 'all changed cells became:', set(d[3] for d in diff))
# were all changed cells zero in input?
print('all input zeros?', all(d[2]==0 for d in diff))
